reader.requirement: At --std 85 a Format 2 RECORD IS VARYING clause makes the file's records variable length, with integer-2 the smallest and integer-3 the largest record any output statement may write (each defaulting to the least/greatest record description, GR6/GR7), so a WRITE/REWRITE outside the range fails with status 44 and a record inside it is stored at its own length, with or without DEPENDING ON, for every organization.

edition-consulted.switches: VaryingRecordInfo.BoundsEnforced: DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize, but the clause is ORed with varyingClause, so a Format 2 clause enforces its bounds at every edition (the switch governs Format 3 only)
Since column: SR2 (both arms), SR3, SR4 rows are 85, screened as at 2023
FROM 0 is refused at 85 (§1985:III.2 has no allowance) while 2023's SR7 admits it

reader.notes: VaryMin/VaryMax take the stated integers (BoundsEnforced is always true for Format 2) or the least/greatest record description, and FileConnector.Stored returns null (status 44) outside them. All four phrase combinations and the no-DEPENDING ODO form behave as GR4/GR6/GR7 state on sequential and relative files.

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-024/r2_gr4_vary.cob (--std 85, run dir r2_gr4_vary-002) aimed at what the reader's p2 did not try: (1) integer-3 (30) larger than the only record description (20), which SR2 permits: T25=00 T30=00 T31=44 T20=00 and READ back LT=25, 30, 20 then 10, so integer-3, not the description, is the maximum (GR4); (2) no DEPENDING with two fixed descriptions 8 and 20 (GR10b/GR12b): NR1 W=[AAAAAAAA            ], NR2 W=[BBBB...B] (each record at its own length, INTO a group move); (3) an INDEXED file FROM 5 TO 20 DEPENDING: WRITE I4=44 I21=44 I5=00 I20=00, READ LI=05, REWRITE IRW21=44 IRW4=44 IRW12=00, READ back LI=12.
